title: cordylanthus rigidus var. littoralis
intro: Cordylanthus rigidus var. littoralis, commonly known as Beach Plume, is a perennial herb native to the coastal regions of California. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Cordylanthus rigidus var. littoralis include its ability to stimulate digestion, ease respiratory issues, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds.
